title: Infinity Policy v1
description: The rules the kernel applies. Only version and policy_id are required; the three lists default to empty. As with proposals, the kernel is more lenient than this contract (it ignores unknown fields and denies a wrong version as UNKNOWN_POLICY_VERSION).

effects_requiring_approval.description: Effects that wait for a human (APPROVAL_REQUIRED).

risks_requiring_approval.description: Risk levels that wait for a human (APPROVAL_REQUIRED).
